# .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/task.md

---

name: 📝 Task
about: Create a general work item or task.
title: "[TASK] Concise description of the task"
labels: ['task', 'to-do']
assignees: ''

---

## Task Description

Clearly describe the task to be performed. What is the objective of this task?
Be as specific as possible about what needs to be done.

## Completion / Acceptance Criteria (Optional)

How will we know this task is complete? Define the criteria that must be met to consider it done.

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Context / Justification (Optional)

Why is this task necessary? What does it contribute to or what problem does it solve?
(e.g., "This is part of the preparation phase for...", "Required for project organization", "Follow-up on a meeting point")

## Additional Notes (Optional)

Any other relevant information, links to resources, or details that might help the person performing the task.
